title: Conference room with projection screen, long marble table and multiple chairs
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.
One ceiling-mounted projector is visible near the centre of the ceiling (mounted above the far end of the table).
One large retractable projection screen is visible on the far wall, lowered.
One long rectangular conference table with a white marble-like surface is visible occupying the centre of the room.

At least eleven individual office chairs with black seats/backs and five-star caster bases are visible around the table: six chairs are along the left side of the table (image left, some partially cropped) and five chairs are along the right side of the table (image right).
One small wheeled floor device (likely an air purifier or similar) is visible on the floor at the near-right corner of the table (partly in front of the table leg).
Three small potted plants or planters are visible on the centre strip of the table (two nearer the far end, one nearer the near end).
One hand-sanitiser or liquid bottle is visible on the table near the centre toward the near end.
One red rectangular box (possibly a tissue or supply box) is visible on the table near the far half.
One black cable runs along the table from near the near end toward the centre channel in the tabletop.
Glass partition walls are visible on both the left and the right sides of the room (full-height glazing on the right with an interior view beyond; left side shows a frosted/transparent glazed wall).
spatial_relations: The projection screen is mounted on the far wall and is directly aligned with the long axis of the conference table.
The ceiling-mounted projector is centred over the far half of the table and projects toward the lowered screen on the far wall.
The long table occupies the central floor area, with a row of chairs on each long side: six along the image-left side and five along the image-right side as counted in the photograph.
A glass partition runs along the right side of the room, with visible interior space beyond the glass; a glazed wall or door is on the left side of the room.
The wheeled floor device (air-purifier-like) is positioned at the near-right corner of the table, directly in front of the near table leg and slightly intruding into the walkway beside the table.
Small plants and supply items are placed along a recessed centre channel on the tabletop, roughly spaced along the middle of the table.
colours_and_materials: Tabletop appears white with grey marble-like veining; surface has a glossy appearance.
Chairs are black with mesh or fabric backs and black caster bases.
Carpet is a light-to-medium grey with a low-pile texture.
Walls and lower wall panels are white; the projection screen is white.
Right and left side walls are glass (transparent on the right, partially frosted or coated on the left).
Ceiling is white with rectangular recessed lighting panels; the projector has a light grey or white casing.
uncertainties: The single transcribed visible text 'Dettol' is identified from the liquid bottle label; smaller labels and brand markings on the projector and the wheeled floor device are not legible at this resolution.

Counts of chairs (six left, five right) are based on individually distinguishable chairs visible in this image; some chairs at the far ends or behind the table may be partially obscured or cropped and the total may not represent all chairs in the room.
The wheeled floor device is visually identified by form only; its exact function, model or brand is unreadable and therefore not confirmed.
Small printed text on the projector housing and on the near-floor device is present but unreadable in this photo; other small labels in the scene were not legible on a second visual pass.
